messages:
mayra: Heads-up: OptimaSys (SI) and TitanCompute (HW partner) asked for an air-gapped observability bundle. Goal: Datadog-style dashboards and traces without any direct SaaS egress. Can we support?

tom: We can. Idea: ship an OTEL Collector binary + a local Datadog Agent adapter that writes to an on-prem Datadog Gateway or S3 for later relay. Need to confirm licensing with marketing.

ash: For the runtime, we should emit the same span attributes we use in hosted: `model.name`, `model.alias`, `quant_profile`, `cache_hit`, `inference.ms`, `gpu_serial`. Keeps dashboards consistent.

gabe: SI wants an install flow: 2 commands max, and an offline sample that produces traces + GPU metrics. I'll draft an ansible playbook.

mayra: Good. Also we need a security note: HSM/KMS integration is customer-specific; document the steps for KMS config in the private bundle.

tom: Example OTEL collector config for air-gapped mode (collector sends to local receiver):

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
processors:
  batch: {}
exporters:
  file:
    path: /var/log/redwood/otel-output.json
pipelines:
  traces:
    receivers: [otlp]
    processors: [batch]
    exporters: [file]
  metrics:
    receivers: [otlp]
    processors: [batch]
    exporters: [file]
```

Note: the `file` exporter is for the demo bundle. SI will ship a forwarder that pulls the file and pushes to their internal Datadog gateway.

ash: We'll also include a small helper that converts our trace JSON to Datadog trace format (python script). I'll add it to the bundle.

gabe: For the marketplace tile (private marketplace), product wants a co-branded screenshot showing a trace view + GPU heatmap. Can ops produce sample data?

deploy-bot: infra-bot: Demo infra deployed: `optima-airgap-demo` (cluster id: c-3f6b). GPU exporter flagged as enabled.

mayra: Perfect. Action items: gabe -> ansible + sample artifacts; ash -> converter script + example traces; tom -> finalize OTEL config + node-exporter GPU labels; mayra -> draft security/KMS notes and coordinate legal for distribution.

gabe: I'll put the ansible and a README with 2-step install in a repo and share the link here when ready.

ash: Quick note on naming: the converter script will map `inference.ms` -> `duration.ms` for Datadog span compatibility and add `resource.attributes.gpu_family`.

mayra: Scheduling a 30m sync with OptimaSys + TitanCompute for tomorrow 9am PT to confirm handoff and launch timeline.

tom: Suggest recording the sync and getting their checklist (network/firewall, certs, storage).

gabe: Ack. I'll include typical firewall rules in the README (allow internal port 4317 between runtime and collector).

mayra: Thanks team. This bundle could unlock a lot of on-prem deals if the install is frictionless. Keep updates short here.
